rec.warningTitle: Check the law before recording calls
rec.warning: Some places require every party to agree to a recording (in the US, for example {states}); elsewhere a clear notice and a lawful basis are required. Recording is off unless you switch it on for a jurisdiction with a disclosure, which is played before the call connects. This is not legal advice.
